title: Playing in Clyde Kerr's band and picking up the saxophone quickly
summary: He describes Kerr's small band and how teachers marveled at his solos, which he credits to starting late and focusing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
